Warehousing

Largura do Corredor

The measured distance between racks or shelving units in a warehouse aisle, critical for safe equipment movement and determined by facility design and safety codes.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Largura do Corredor?

In this glossary, Largura do Corredor refers to: The measured distance between racks or shelving units in a warehouse aisle, critical for safe equipment movement and determined by facility design and safety codes.

How is Largura do Corredor used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A largura do corredor deve acomodar o raio de giro dos equipamentos e consta na documentação do projeto do armazém."

Why does Largura do Corredor matter in logistics?

Largura do Corredor matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Largura do Corredor?

Largura do Corredor is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Largura do Corredor belong to?

In this glossary, Largura do Corredor is grouped under Warehousing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The measured distance between racks or shelving units in a warehouse aisle, critical for safe equipment movement and determined by facility design and safety codes.

Operational example

Aisle width must accommodate the turning radius of material-handling equipment and is specified in warehouse design documentation.

Localized term

Largura do Corredor

Localized example

A largura do corredor deve acomodar o raio de giro dos equipamentos e consta na documentação do projeto do armazém.
